quote: To effectively assess biases in ASR systems, we employ three key metrics ... WER ... CER ... BERTScore ... WER provides a direct measure of transcription accuracy at the word level ... CER offers insight into the accuracy of finer transcription details ... BERTScore assesses this aspect, with a score closer to 1 indicating greater semantic similarity.

We employ three key metrics, each offering a unique lens on transcription accuracy and semantic fidelity. The first metric is the word error rate (WER)... In conjunction with WER, we analyze the character error rate (CER)... Our third metric, BERTScore, examines semantic similarity between predicted and target sentences.
